property_summary: For any call where msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, if the balance is transferred, it must be when block.number % 15 == 0 (block-based), not based on block.timestamp; the buggy version transfers when block.timestamp % 15 == 0 instead.
change_summary: Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.timestamp % 15 == 0, modifying the condition for balance transfer from block-based to time-based.
